summary: Global Ship Lease, Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a quarterly cash dividend of $0.546875 per depositary share on its 8.75% Series B Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Shares for the period April 1, 2026 to June 30, 2026. The dividend will be paid on July 1, 2026 to holders of record as of June 24, 2026. This is a routine periodic dividend declaration, not a special situation. The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change.
